title: Parcel carrier cut its collection capacity
brief: Next-day delivery promises for UK customers on small kitchen appliances have been missed since Tuesday 11 Nov. Find the root cause and an action plan.

evidence.content: ParcelFast on-time delivery from the Coventry DC fell from 97% to 71% since Tue 11 Nov.
From 11 Nov, daily collection capacity at Coventry is reduced from 4,000 to 2,500 parcels because of a driver shortage.
Coventry packs about 3,800 parcels a day; since Tuesday roughly 1,300 packed parcels a day are left on the dock overnight.
Small-appliance orders are 4% above forecast: normal seasonal uplift.
No supplier issues; all small-appliance SKUs are in stock.
A second carrier contract (SwiftLine) has 1,500 parcels/day of spare collection capacity at Coventry and has been unused since September.

answer_key.root_cause: ParcelFast cut daily collection capacity at Coventry from 4,000 to 2,500 parcels from 11 Nov, so about 1,300 packed parcels a day miss collection and next-day promises.

remediation_rubric.criterion: Clear the backlog (extra/weekend collections) and adjust delivery promises or cut-off times
Monitor carrier capacity notices; capacity SLA in the carrier contract

answer_key.notes: The notice (E2) was dated 5 Nov: it was known a week in advance.

registry.mechanism_opportunities: Logistics findings must reach Inventory (who holds the SwiftLine contract); in D0 the coordinator relays them, in V1 they can bypass.
registry.expected_timing: Cause in round 1; best plan needs E6 (round 2).
registry.favoritism_notes: Favours V1 (relay-heavy by design). Balanced by HO-03/HO-08 where bypass risks dropping useful detail.
